name: pi-ralph
description: Pi-native Ralph-style feature loop implemented as a project-local pi extension with a long-lived controller, fresh coder attempts, and read-only testers.

coder.description: Fresh coding worker. Can edit code but cannot run acceptance gates or mark pass/fail.

backendTester.description: Read-only tester for non-browser verification and feature-specific backend/product behavior checks.

playwrightTester.description: Read-only browser tester for end-to-end and UI acceptance checks.

backend.description: Read-only tester driven by a feature-specific backend/product test spec.

playwright.description: Read-only browser tester driven by a feature-specific Playwright/e2e test spec.

grillMe.title: Interactive /grill-me questionnaire extension
grillMe.goal: Create a reusable pi-native grounded clarification extension that lets pi ask the user concise, structured questions one at a time instead of dumping a long wall of text into chat, can ground on explicitly mentioned files plus session context, persists draft answers safely to a temp JSON file, supports quick review/editing in the TUI, surfaces provenance, and routes submitted answers back to either the active session or the calling tool flow depending on how it was invoked.

scope.part1a: Done: build the standalone reusable questionnaire engine and expose it through /grill-me with a built-in fallback question set, review/edit flow, draft persistence, debounced updates while typing, failure-safe cleanup semantics, and manual submit-as-user-message behavior.
scope.part1b: Next: shift /grill-me from session/focus-only generation into a grounded clarification system that reads explicitly mentioned artifacts first, combines them with session context, detects thin context honestly, supports quick/deep question budgets, exposes an agent-callable grill_me tool with explicit artifacts and mode parameters, surfaces provenance, and upgrades the input UX for long answers and artifact hints.
scope.part2: Wire the same grounded questionnaire engine into future clarification workflows so planning flows can generate or inject questions, collect answers, and write clarifications back into PRD.md and per-feature markdown files.

implementationReview.summary: The current implementation is a solid reusable questionnaire engine and already includes dynamic generation, the agent-callable tool, safer cleanup semantics, and debounced draft persistence, but it still falls short of the clarified grounded-questioning product direction.
strengths: project-local pi extension structure is good
dynamic generation from session context plus focus already exists
failure-safe submit cleanup and debounced draft persistence are already implemented
TUI flow is clean and tested

findings.summary: Question generation still relies on focus plus session context and does not read explicitly mentioned project artifacts before asking deeper questions.

In fresh or thin-context sessions the generator can ask file-specific or plan-specific questions without enough grounding, instead of first admitting the lack of context and asking for or gathering grounding.
The extension does not clearly surface what a questionnaire was based on, such as provided definition, mentioned files, session context, thin-context generation, or fallback.

The current answer input behaves like a horizontal-scrolling field instead of a wrapped editor-like surface, which makes longer answers difficult to edit and does not support artifact mention affordances.

keyConsiderations: definition stays first-class and bypasses grounding plus generation entirely
there is no default artifact set; only explicitly mentioned files, session context, or exploratory grounding should be used
grill_me should remain a single grounded questionnaire round, with follow-up rounds owned by the agent or workflow rather than hidden inside the extension
grounding should prefer mentioned artifacts plus session context before deeper question generation
thin-context behavior should be outcome-first and honest about missing grounding
support explicit quick versus deep question budgets instead of one implicit question count strategy
provenance should be visible in the UI and tool results

commandArgs.artifactHints: prefer @mentioned files where the command surface allows; raw file path parsing is an acceptable fallback UX
notes: do not assume a default artifact set
mentioned files should be read in full before deeper question generation when feasible
exact slash-command parsing for mentions can follow pi command-surface constraints
examples: /grill-me refine the extension behavior using @plan.json and @PRD.md

tool.name: grill_me
tool.purpose: let the agent ask the user a single grounded clarification round instead of emitting a large question block in chat
tool.focusArg: optional freeform focus string supplied by the agent
tool.modeArg: optional quick | deep question budget selector
tool.artifactsArg: optional list of explicit file or artifact paths to ground on before generation
tool.definitionArg: optional injected questionnaire definition; bypasses grounding and generation entirely
tool.resultDelivery: returns structured answers as the tool result in the same turn

invocationModes.manualCommand: user runs /grill-me with optional focus and artifact hints; submitted answers are sent back into the active session as a normal user message
invocationModes.agentTool: agent calls grill_me with optional focus, mode, artifacts, or definition and receives structured answers as the tool result without sendUserMessage

precedence: provided definition bypasses grounding and generation
thin-context exploratory or outcome-first generation when grounding is insufficient
bundled default questionnaire only as a last-resort fallback
questionSource.artifactGrounding: only explicitly mentioned or provided files should be auto-read
questionSource.sessionContext: always eligible grounding input when available
questionSource.thinContextPolicy: if grounding is insufficient, ask exploratory or outcome-first questions instead of pretending to know unseen artifacts
questionSource.fileSpecificQuestionRule: do not ask file-specific questions unless those files were actually read or summarized into context

grounding.explorationPolicy: when context is thin, explore or ask for grounding before deeper artifact-specific questions

questionGeneration.shape: generated questions must match the shared questionnaire schema
qualityBar: questions should be specific to the current task, artifacts, or ambiguity
questions should avoid asking for information already present in the grounded context
questions should remain answerable in a compact terminal flow
when context is thin, bias the first question toward intended outcome or missing grounding
do not ask file-specific questions unless those files were actually loaded or summarized

notes: multiline remains available in the schema for forward compatibility
recommendation is optional and only shown when present

manualCommandBehavior.questionnaireSource: use provided definition if injected; otherwise ground on explicitly mentioned artifacts plus session context when possible, fall back to thin-context exploratory questions when necessary, and use the bundled questionnaire only as a last resort
manualCommandBehavior.submitFlow: send a wrapped JSON payload back into the active pi session as a normal user message

agentToolBehavior.questionnaireSource: use provided definition if passed; otherwise ground on explicit artifacts plus session context, with honest thin-context generation before fallback
agentToolBehavior.submitFlow: return structured answers as the tool result in the same turn so the agent can continue immediately

followupPolicy.ownership: grill_me itself runs one grounded questionnaire round
followupPolicy.workflowControl: additional rounds are decided explicitly by the user, agent, or workflow outside the extension rather than by a hidden autonomous loop
followupPolicy.recommendedPractice: one to two rounds is typical; larger planning tasks may justify a third round, but that remains workflow policy rather than hardcoded extension behavior

answerBehavior.enter: save current answer and advance to next question
answerBehavior.escape: close questionnaire and keep current temp draft

inputUX.editingSurface: replace the current horizontal-scrolling input with a wrapped editor-like input
inputUX.longAnswers: long answers must remain visible and editable without text disappearing off-screen
inputUX.artifactMentions: support @mention affordances for artifact hints where applicable in pi TUI surfaces
notes: answers may still serialize as strings in v1 even when the editor surface is visually wrapped
input UX should feel native inside pi rather than like a single-line terminal prompt

reviewBehavior.mode: review list with native up/down selection
reviewBehavior.answerRows: selecting an answer row with Enter returns to that question for editing and then returns immediately to review after save
reviewBehavior.submitAction: submit appears as a selectable review action instead of a custom hotkey
reviewBehavior.cancelAction: cancel appears as a selectable review action and also remains available via Escape

updateStrategy.typing: debounced persistence during active editing instead of synchronous disk writes on every keystroke
updateStrategy.objective: preserve in-progress answers while keeping the TUI responsive

manualCommand.mode: send a wrapped JSON payload back into the active pi session as a normal user message

agentTool.mode: return structured answers as the tool result in the same turn

workItems.title: Define questionnaire and response types
workItems.goal: Create the stable internal data model for questions, answers, draft state, and submission payloads so the UI and future planners share the same contract.

workItems.title: Implement temp draft storage
workItems.goal: Write and update .pi/tmp/grill-me.json during the interview, overwrite it on each new run, and preserve the latest draft when the user cancels.

workItems.title: Create built-in default questionnaire source
workItems.goal: Bundle a sensible default design-grilling questionnaire as a fallback source for cases where dynamic generation cannot produce a useful targeted set.

workItems.title: Build one-question-at-a-time TUI flow
workItems.goal: Render question entry, progress indicator, answer editing, and review navigation in a simple native-feeling pi custom UI.
acceptanceNotes: Question screen shows title, question number, progress, current question, optional recommendation, and answer input
Review screen uses up/down navigation and Enter-to-edit for a selected answer
Review screen also includes selectable Submit and Cancel actions

workItems.title: Register manual /grill-me and submit results back into session
workItems.goal: Expose the command, launch the questionnaire, and on submit send a wrapped JSON result back into the active pi conversation as a normal user message.

workItems.title: Stabilize a reusable questionnaire API for future planning workflows
workItems.goal: Keep the questionnaire runner generic so later flows can supply generated question sets without rewriting the UI or storage logic.

workItems.title: Add session-context-aware generation with provided-definition bypass
workItems.goal: Generate a short targeted questionnaire from session context plus optional focus when no explicit definition is supplied. Keep provided definition injection first-class, and use the bundled default questionnaire only as a fallback.

workItems.title: Add agent-callable grill_me clarification tool
workItems.goal: Register a custom tool the agent can call when it needs clarification, launch the same questionnaire UI during tool execution, and return structured answers as the tool result in the same turn.

workItems.title: Expand /grill-me to accept optional focus args and generated questions
workItems.goal: Use context-aware generation for /grill-me, incorporate optional user-supplied focus text, and keep the existing idle-only behavior and manual submit-as-user-message flow.

workItems.title: Make submit and cleanup semantics failure-safe
workItems.goal: Move draft deletion out of the generic questionnaire runner and only delete the draft after successful session handoff or successful tool completion. Preserve the completed draft if delivery fails.

workItems.title: Debounce draft persistence while force-flushing on navigation boundaries
workItems.goal: Keep in-progress answers recoverable without performing synchronous disk writes on every keystroke. Persist through a short debounce during typing, and force-flush on Enter, Shift+Tab, Escape, submit, and cancel.

workItems.title: Teach the agent to prefer grill_me over long clarification blocks
workItems.goal: Add tool prompt metadata and invocation guidance so the extension advertises itself as the preferred clarification path when the agent needs multiple user answers but the user should stay in a compact one-question-at-a-time flow.

workItems.title: Add artifact-aware grounding from explicit mentions and tool artifacts
workItems.goal: Before deeper question generation, read explicitly mentioned or provided artifacts and combine them with session context. Do not introduce a convention-based default artifact set.

workItems.title: Detect thin context and switch to exploratory or outcome-first questioning
workItems.goal: If the session is fresh or grounding is insufficient, avoid pretending to know unseen files. Ask grounding or outcome-first questions instead of artifact-specific questions until enough context exists.

workItems.title: Add quick and deep modes for bounded question budgets
workItems.goal: Support explicit quick versus deep question budgets for both the slash command and the grill_me tool while keeping definition injection as a direct bypass path.

workItems.title: Expose grounding provenance in UI and tool results
workItems.goal: Surface what the questionnaire was based on, including provided definition, explicit artifacts, session context, thin-context generation, or fallback, so the operator can judge how grounded the questions are.

workItems.title: Upgrade the answer input to a wrapped editor-like surface
workItems.goal: Replace the current horizontal-scrolling answer input with a wrapped editor-like experience so longer answers remain visible and editable, and support artifact mention affordances where the pi TUI surface allows.

part2Preview.title: Feature clarification planner integration
part2Preview.goal: Generate or assemble feature-specific clarification questions, collect answers through the same questionnaire engine, then write those clarifications back into PRD.md and per-feature markdown so spec generation becomes stronger and more grounded.
plannedOutputs: updated per-feature 001-name.md files with clarification context
structured Q/A payloads reusable by planning tools

features.title: Bootstrap local pi extension development workspace
features.summary: Set up the TypeScript, Vitest, and ESLint workspace so the extension can be built and tested inside this repo.

features.title: Create Ralph runtime folders and typed config/state loaders
features.summary: Establish .pi/ralph runtime files and extension-side storage/config modules for config.json, state.json, roles, and run history.

features.title: Implement manifest schema, loader, and dependency selectors
features.summary: Load features.json, validate roles/testTypes/features, and compute next-ready, blocked, and complete states deterministically.

features.title: Create extension entrypoint and operator commands
features.summary: Register the ralph extension and basic slash commands for status, next, start, stop, and settings stubs.

features.title: Add fresh coder worker runner with strict no-test boundaries
features.summary: Spawn a fresh pi coder attempt for a single feature using the coder prompt, structured output tags, and a toolset that can edit but cannot run gates.

features.title: Implement deterministic command gates
features.summary: Run machine gates like lint, typecheck, and unit tests as structured command results that do not rely on an agent.

features.title: Add read-only backend tester runner
features.summary: Dispatch backend test requests to a read-only tester role that consumes per-feature backend test specs and can never edit code.

features.title: Build retry loop controller with git reset to base SHA
features.summary: Orchestrate coding then testing attempts, reset the working tree to the pre-attempt SHA on failure, and stop after configured retry limits.

features.title: Implement pass/fail state transitions, single commit on pass, and run logs
features.summary: On all-test pass, update status, append logs, create exactly one feature commit, and persist failed or blocked outcomes without coder-side commits.

features.title: Add persisted settings and /ralph-settings TUI
features.summary: Expose controller settings like maxAttemptsPerFeature, maxBlockedResponses, autoAdvance, and showPanel through config.json and a small pi settings UI.

features.title: Show live progress in footer and widgets
features.summary: Render minimal live stats in the footer and above/below editor widgets so the operator can see current feature, counts, attempts, tokens, and loop state.

features.title: Add toggleable right-side stats panel overlay
features.summary: Provide a simple overlay-based side panel that can be toggled on and off and shows the same core loop metrics without replacing the main chat UI.

features.title: Wire Playwright tester profile into the manifest-driven test dispatcher
features.summary: Support features that declare playwright tests by routing them to a dedicated read-only tester role with the playwright-cli skill.

features.title: Add end-to-end dogfood fixtures and documentation
features.summary: Create a sample project fixture and end-to-end smoke coverage so the loop can prove it can read a manifest, execute one feature, gate it, and advance.
